versions.content: In case the PerInstanceMemory or arTypedPerInstance- Memory is used as a permanent RAM Block for the NvRam manager the name for the instantiated PerInstanceMemory or arTypedPerInstanceMemory shall be taken from the input information RteNvmRamBlockLocationSymbol . Otherwise the RTE generator is free to choose an arbitrary name.
